spoken_first_2s: मैं अपनी दुकान से कितना कमा लेता हूं चलो

notes.hook: money question ('dukan se kitna kama leta hoon?') answered only in the last line
notes.what_goes_wrong: The middle (refilling namkeen boxes, 4-10s) is filler; a running earnings tally on screen would hold people to the reveal.
notes.reusable_pattern: Open on the money question everyone is curious about, hold the number until the last line, and show the day's grind in between.
